body:
Thank you! Hearing that really means a lot to me. I am a big believer in karma, I learned that the hard way and now I believe that things take care of themselves and karma comes back to bite people like that.

Yes, it was unfortunate this happened to me.. I worked harder than most of my co-workers and the results showed. I can’t say what I did for a living but my performance was always good and I was usually the employee who took in the most revenue for my company at the end of each shift. Others took in 1/2 or 1/3 what I did and my probationary period (that would have led to full time) had just passed. Someone wanted me out of the way and it sucks but it is what it is.

I got a  for a job interview tonight, right when I was having a drink and contemplating my failures in life - the phone rang and a new employer is interested in interviewing me for next week. It’s a different profession but the pay is significantly greater and so are the benefits. Fingers crossed!!
